regions.merged_text: God bless you Miss Panyard, many thanks for your kind favor Rech and noted yesterday -- carbons, book, violin strings, etc. May the divine Infant reward you shortly -- and in the end be Himself your reward . . . . A Bl. Christmas to you and yours and a peaceful, Happy New Year.
